name: Fabtech Technologies Cleanrooms Pvt Ltd
india_angle: Fabtech Technologies Cleanrooms Pvt Ltd is headquartered in Mumbai and manufactures cleanroom solutions in Gujarat, Telangana, and Maharashtra.
summary: Fabtech Technologies Cleanrooms Pvt Ltd provides turnkey cleanroom solutions, including design, build, and validation services, specifically tailored for semiconductor and other critical industries. Their expertise in cleanroom HVAC systems and compliance with ISO 14644 standards ensures high-quality environments for sensitive manufacturing processes.
